$comment: Candidate-level evidence for A5 visual control and theming fidelity. Token reach remains pairing-level in evidence.json; this file records whether the mapped visual system stays authoritative across both hosts and how much corrective alias work was required.

react-aria.basis: UNDRR-owned component CSS consumes the tokens directly in both hosts
react-aria.evidence: React Aria supplies behaviour and state semantics rather than an upstream visual language, so the shared UNDRR layer remains the visual authority.

mui.basis: one supported createTheme mapping is shared by both hosts
mui.evidence: The shared MUI theme reaches palette, typography, spacing, shape, z-index and focus treatment. Mangrove requires host-containment repair, but the resulting MUI controls still follow the project theme.

antd.basis: seed tokens reach the suite, but derived aliases and host cascade limit authority
antd.evidence: Four derived text aliases failed contrast and were pinned manually. On Mangrove, unlayered host form rules override the themed Ant control height, border and radius.

mantine.basis: theme mapping works after colour-ramp, focus and host-collision correction
mantine.evidence: Mantine requires ten-shade ramps, has no focus-colour or z-index-scale theme fields, and needs host-specific collision repair. One pairing also records unreachable tokens.

carbon.basis: Carbon retains IBM visual conventions and has incomplete UNDRR token reach
carbon.evidence: Roughly 30% of the evaluated tokens are unreachable, so the supported Carbon theme cannot express the complete UNDRR visual system.
